paired_array_definition: Mean difference,lower,upper of95percent paired system-bootstrap interval; exploratory marginal intervals. Seeds reported separately, not treated as additional independent validation systems.
replication_findings: A beats B on bond/clash/angle/RMSF/torsion-increment errors in both seeds; B beats A on MSD error in both. Same architecture/exposure and MD-only initialization make this a paired recipe result, not a universal superiority claim for flow or diffusion.

A improves bond/clash/angle/torsion-increment errors over historical h/v in both seeds. A RMSF differences remain unresolved in both. A MSD improvement excludes zero in seed71 but not72; do not claim replicated significant motion improvement from MSD alone.
B improves clash and MSD errors over h/v in both seeds but worsens RMSF/torsion-increment errors. Its bond advantage excludes zero only in seed71.

A improves RMSF error over released PVB in both seeds, but remains worse on bond/clash/MSD in both. Retain both favorable and unfavorable outcomes. PVB native inputs and released pretraining differ, so not an equal-resource causal comparison.

seed72_complete_path_followup.coverage: All48 systems,96 conditions,192 source-sampled draws per model; reused complete raw outputs;0 additional model calls
seed72_complete_path_followup.replication: Both A/B improve all four CA path fair-energy scores over PVB in both seeds. A versus h/v remains unresolved on all four in both seeds; B improves pair-distance paths over h/v in both, other three unresolved. A beats B on CA-increment paths in both; other three A/B differences unresolved. These positive distributional results coexist with poor all-atom geometry and weak frame ordering. Two draws do not establish a correct joint or equilibrium distribution.

seed72_temporal_order.definition: One minus chronological lagged squared distance divided by exact frame-permutation expectation; compare to MD, not simply maximize
seed72_temporal_order.interpretation: The near-zero adjacency advantage of both coordinate recipes repeats across training seeds. PVB instead overstates adjacency relative to MD and is not dynamical ground truth. Coordinate increment anticorrelation near-0.5 is descriptive, compatible with framewise jitter but not proof of conditional independence or of the architecture being the unique cause. Static pretraining is not assumed to fix the temporal deficit.

seed72_amplitude_bins.replication: Both seeds suppress high-motion finite-window RMSF; B's better high-bin MSD coexists with worse RMSF profile and geometry than A. This does not support labeling B a superior large-motion generator or imposing a displacement cap on either arm.

seed72_clock80_100.coverage: 48 systems,96 fixed observed histories,2 draws per grid/model;0 new neural calls
seed72_clock80_100.replication: Both seeds/recipes show no resolved displacement-response benefit over zero-response and only a small fluctuation-response benefit. A/B clock-error differences are unresolved in both seeds. Reduced error versus the historical h/v path does not mean correct physical time sensitivity. Protein80ps is below protein TRAIN minimum although complex TRAIN includes80ps.
